end.summary:
Factorisation by finding two numbers for x² + px + q was practised; 3 of 7 attempts were unaided correct.
Common-factor extraction was practised in 2 attempts, both unaided correct.
Arjun first copied coefficients in (x + 5)(x + 6), then corrected this to (x + 2)(x + 3) using sum and product checks.
For negative values, Arjun selected number pairs but still mixed up signs in the final factors; this was not corrected after the last occurrence.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised taking out a common factor and factorising quadratics by finding two numbers whose sum is p and product is q. Arjun used the sum-and-product check to correct the coefficient-copying mix-up, and correctly factorised examples such as x² + 7x + 12. Sign choices with negative values still need practice and were not corrected after the last example. At home, ask Arjun to check both expansion and the signs after each factorisation.
